name: AudioMC
intro: Audio MultiChallenge 先用 Planner/Tester 在最大轮数内寻找目标音频模型失败；若始终未失败则丢弃。约 65% 的人工尝试使用合成失败蓝图，其余来自直接人工种子，人工录音本身也必须在最终轮观察到失败后才编写原子量规，再经三阶段质检发布。
build_method: Agentic 失败蓝图生成, 无脚本人类多轮录音, 原子二元评分标准, 三级质量审核
metric: 平均通过率（APR）, 平均评分标准得分（ARS）
eval_feature: 多轮, 长文本, 语音编辑
scale: 452 段对话，47 名说话人，14.99 小时音频，1,712 条原子量规
drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with AudioMC arXiv:2512.14865v1 Section 2.2, Figure 3, Section 3, Appendices A.4 and A.6, and Hugging Face revision 90ea.... The diagram adds the synthetic success loop and maximum-turn discard, keeps both the approximately 65% blueprint-guided human attempts and direct human seeds, applies a second failure decision to the human recording, writes atomic rubrics only for the final failure turn, preserves three-stage QC, and records 452 conversations, 47 speakers, 14.99 hours, and 1,712 rubrics.
build_method_en: Agentic failure-blueprint generation, unscripted human multi-turn recordings, atomic binary rubrics, three-stage quality review
intro_en: Audio MultiChallenge first uses a Planner/Tester loop to seek a target-audio-model failure before a maximum turn count, discarding attempts that never fail. About 65 percent of human attempts use a synthetic failure blueprint and the rest include direct human seeds; the human recording must itself exhibit a final-turn failure before atomic rubrics are written and the item passes three-stage QC.
